name: orb-reveal
title: Orb Reveal
description: An onboarding hero built around a thick liquid-glass orb. Hold it and it swells while a deep blue smile of light glows through it; drag it up and it shrinks into a glass button, showing your title through the lens on the way — magnified in the middle, mirrored around the bevel, with a rainbow fringe — then glass marbles fountain out of it into a heart. Drag it back down and the marbles float away.
